data.name: Anil
data.gender_notes: Anil is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Anil means 'Breath' or 'Air'. This name is rooted in Hindu mythology, where the God of Wind is called 'Vayu' or 'Pavan', and Anil can be considered a diminutive or variant form. The name Anil carries the meaning “Breath, Air” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anil usually hope their child will grow to embody breath, air and live with faith, good character and purpose.
